blockers.summary: Launcher reads plan["interpreter"] which is absent from calibration-plan.json; KeyError occurs after the one-shot marker is created at line 119-121.
blockers.failure_scenario: Parent authorizes the reservation; launcher writes launch-once.marker, then raises KeyError before spawning the probe. The one-shot authorization is consumed with no probe or result written.
blockers.fix: Add interpreter {resolved_target, sha256} to the plan or pin it in source-pins.json; move marker creation after all pre-spawn checks; re-freeze plan and pins and re-review.

blockers.summary: No live authoritative-state check before hardware; reservation only compares static fields including no_concurrent_long_mps_training.
blockers.failure_scenario: A long best204 training or campaign lease is active when the reservation file still reads no_concurrent_long_mps_training true; the probe starts MPS work and competes with training.
blockers.fix: Pin the authoritative state path and hash in the plan; read it in the launcher before the marker and in the probe immediately before the MPS load; require no active_long_campaign, no active training or MPS job, and no cancel request; record the observed state hash.

blockers.summary: One-shot marker path depends on the output parent directory, so a second launch with a different parent passes while the reservation still reads authorized_once true.
blockers.failure_scenario: Second launch uses a new output parent, creates a fresh marker, and spawns another MPS probe under the same reservation.
blockers.fix: Use a fixed marker path under the calibration directory, for example HERE / "launch-once.marker".

blockers.summary: Freshness and interarrival gates default to zero on empty data; resource_sample_count > 0 is the only sample-count gate.
blockers.failure_scenario: The 8-forward workload finishes in under 1 s with one sample; max gap is 0.0 and max after-read age is 0.0, so the probe passes freshness with no measured steady-state sampling.
blockers.fix: Require a non-empty gap list, a minimum complete sample count derived from the MPS-active window, and an exact guard count (64 construction guards plus 9 per decision iteration across 8 iterations = 136 with GUARD_ACTION_CHUNK = 8 at worker.py:566). Do not relax the 1.0 s or 10 s thresholds.

blockers.summary: Probe is an 8-decision smoke test, not representative load; a pass cannot support steady freshness or IO qualification.
blockers.failure_scenario: Parent treats a single passing 8-forward probe as the representative qualified probe required before the 512-episode campaign.
blockers.fix: Either label any result smoke_only with representative_qualification false, or write a new plan that repeats the synthetic decision loop until the MPS-active window reaches the target duration within the 90 s budget, with fresh review.

narrow_findings.summary: Pins and reservation are checked before the up-to-10 s first-sample wait, not directly before the MPS model load at line 153.
narrow_findings.fix: Move verify_pins and check_reservation to directly before the load_inference_model("best204", device="mps") call.

narrow_findings.summary: ps check=True races with child exit; a vanished PID raises in the monitor, which fails a successful run after the marker is consumed.
narrow_findings.fix: Check process.poll() before each ps call; treat a vanished PID as end of sampling.

narrow_findings.summary: On outer timeout, SIGTERM skips the probe finally block, so probe-result.json and cleanup evidence are not written.
narrow_findings.fix: Record the timeout disposition in the launcher result path; keep the 10 s cleanup budget.

narrow_findings.summary: No tests exercise probe.py, launch_once.py, or SyntheticEnv; first execution is the first test.
narrow_findings.fix: Parent replays focused CPU tests; add a CPU-only dry run of the launcher with stub reservation and stub interpreter in a temp directory, no MPS.
